verdict.rationale: Polar's core platform is open source under Apache-2.0, so the code for the core product is available to run, and it markets itself as 'Open Source & Global Merchant of Record'. However, the pack has no first-party self-hosting guide, deployment instructions or supported self-hosted edition, and its Merchant of Record services (tax remittance, payouts) are inherently hosted. missing for 10: documented self-hosting/deployment guide, official support for self-hosted installs, clarity on which features work self-hosted (MoR/tax/payments), hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: the platform itself is developed in the open at github.com/polarsource/polar (Apache-2.0, 10k+ stars)
